newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Nike shrs keep trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Nike shrs keep trading.

text.p: Nike Inc shares were trading after hours at 58-3/4 against a close of 59 following the release of its quarterly earnings, traders said Wednesday.
"There's very small trading here and there," said one trader.
Nike reported net income for the second quarter of $0.60 per share against $0.34 for the same period last year.
Technology stocks were also trading following an active day on the exchange. Compaq Computer Corp was at 78-5/8, Dell Computer Corp at 56-3/8 and Intel Corp at 136-3/8.
"The techs were still buzzing," the trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 98,500 shares compared with the previous day's 8,500. There was no session two volume, it said.
